appDescription.message: Private end-to-end encrypted Android notification mirroring.

popupBoundary.message: After trusted-device approval, only notifications created by this app can be synchronized. Notifications from other apps remain on Android.

e2eeTestHint.message: Run again after restarting Chrome. The fingerprint must stay identical; replay is accepted once, then rejected as duplicate.

e2eeNotRun.message: Not run in this browser yet.

registrationBoundary.message: Registration grants access to a private instance. It does not trust other devices for E2EE. Real notification synchronization remains disabled until trusted-device approval and relay validation are complete.

trustedDeviceBoundary.message: Synthetic testing only. Exchange the pairing payload out of band and compare the complete safety code on both devices. Importing a payload alone never approves a peer.

pairingStepCreate.message: Step 1 — Create or import an offer

createOffer.message: Create offer on this Chrome device

receivedPayload.message: Payload received from the other device

transferPayload.message: Payload to transfer to the other device

safetyCodeConfirmed.message: I compared the complete code on both devices and it matches

profileRegistered.message: This Chrome profile is registered. Connection status is available in the extension popup.

reconnectRequested.message: Authenticated transport restart requested. Check the popup for connection status.

reconnectRejected.message: Authenticated transport restart was not accepted. Try again after checking the server.

reconnectFailed.message: Authenticated transport restart failed. Check the server and try again.

hostPermissionDenied.message: Server access was not granted. Registration was not attempted.

waitingForAdminApproval.message: Registration received. Ask your server administrator to approve this Chrome profile.

registrationFailed.message: Registration failed. Verify the server address, one-time code, and device name.

registrationUnreadable.message: Stored registration state could not be read. Reopen this page; if the problem remains, register again.

offerPersisted.message: Offer saved. Transfer this payload to the other registered device.

offerAccepted.message: Offer accepted. This device created an approval response. Return it to the device that created the offer.

approvalAccepted.message: Approval response accepted. Both devices must now show the same safety code.

pairingPayloadCopied.message: Pairing payload copied. It contains public identity metadata, not credentials.

clipboardWriteFailed.message: Clipboard write failed. Select and copy the payload manually.

peerApprovedLocal.message: Peer approved locally. The other device must confirm independently.

removeApprovedPeerConfirm.message: Remove the approved Android device? Encrypted delivery will remain unavailable until both devices compare a new safety code and approve each other again.

approvedPeerRemoved.message: Approved Android device removed locally. Complete safety-code approval again to restore trust.

approvedPeerRemovalFailed.message: The approved device could not be removed. The existing trust state remains unchanged; reopen this page and try again.

pairingCancelled.message: Pairing session cancelled. No device was approved by this action.

pairingCancelFailed.message: Pairing could not be cancelled. Reopen this page and try again.

pairingStateInvalid.message: Pairing state could not be verified. Cancel it before starting again.

pairingStepApproval.message: Step 2 — Send this offer, then import the approval response

pairingStepSafetyCode.message: Step 3 — Compare the complete safety code and approve independently

offerOutputLabel.message: Offer — send this once to the other device

approvalOutputLabel.message: Approval response — return this to the offer creator

pairingSessionStillActive.message: $FAILURE$ The previous saved session is still active.

pairingStateRestoreFailed.message: $FAILURE$ Pairing state could not be restored. Cancel it before retrying.

pairingExpired.message: Import rejected: this pairing payload expired. Cancel both sides and create a new offer.

pairingWorkspaceMismatch.message: Import rejected: the devices are registered with different private instances.

pairingApprovalMismatch.message: Import rejected: this approval response does not belong to the active Chrome offer.

pairingMalformed.message: Import rejected: the copied pairing payload is incomplete or malformed.

pairingOfferMissing.message: Import rejected: Chrome no longer has the offer required by this approval response.

pairingSessionConflict.message: Import rejected: another pairing session is active. Cancel it before importing a new offer.

pairingSafetyMismatch.message: Approval rejected: the safety code does not match the active pairing session.

pairingFailed.message: Pairing failed. Verify the payload, expiry, private instance, and current step.
